Ruth: Emberly QBR next Tue — finance asked for a single spend slide + renewal posture.
Evan: I'll pull 45d tokens and do a 2-week spike projection. Noticed a new demo hitting /embeddings every 10m.
Sam: Snapshot: current period tokens = 54.3M, avg daily = 1.8M, recent spike +60% last 6d.
Leena: If spike holds they'll cross soft threshold in ~8 days. Options: 1) short retainer buffer 10-15%, 2) temporary credits, 3) add auto-throttle above 85%.
FinOps-Bot: alert: Emberly retainer usage at 76% of committed; projected crossover in 8 days under sustained spike.
Ruth: Proposed ask: "10% temporary buffer for Q2 with 30-day review + 45m enablement for devs." Keep CFO-friendly.
Evan: I'll make a slide with three scenarios (baseline/sustained/ramp-down) and a cost/latency scatter. Need per-route P95 for last 14d — @Leena can you export?
Leena: Yep, exporting P95 + per-route tokens now and will drop CSV by Thu. Also provisioned 25k emergency credits (expires in 10d) and added account note.
Sam: I'll draft the renewal blurb and two feedback q's: 1) "How do you prioritize latency vs predictable spend?" 2) "Would a short enablement session to reduce embed costs be helpful?"
Ruth: Action items: Evan - deck + visuals (Fri EOD); Leena - CSV + policy draft; Sam - blurb + feedback qs; Ruth - schedule QBR and invite finance lead. Using this thread as canonical. :white_check_mark:
